title: Mimikatz Credential Dumper — Generic
author: Benjamin Delpy / Florian Roth
description: Detects known Mimikatz strings and API sequences used to dump LSASS credentials.
rule_body: rule Mimikatz_Generic { meta: author="Florian Roth" description="Detects Mimikatz strings" strings: $s1 = "sekurlsa::logonpasswords" ascii wide $s2 = "privilege::debug" ascii wide $s3 = "mimikatz" ascii wide condition: 2 of them }

title: Cobalt Strike Beacon Configuration Block
author: Florian Roth
description: Detects encoded Cobalt Strike beacon configuration blocks in memory or on disk.
rule_body: rule Cobalt_Strike_Beacon_Config { meta: reference="Cobalt Strike" strings: $c1 = { 00 01 00 01 00 02 } $c2 = { 00 02 00 01 00 02 } condition: uint16(0)==0x5A4D and any of ($c*) }

title: Emotet Loader DLL
author: Yara-Rules community
description: Detects Emotet loader packer stubs on disk.
rule_body: rule Emotet_Loader { meta: family="Emotet" strings: $a = "emo_task_" $b = { 8B 45 08 8B 4D 0C 8B 55 10 } condition: uint16(0)==0x5A4D and all of them }

title: LockBit 3.0 Ransomware Payload
author: Florian Roth
description: Detects LockBit 3.0 ransomware payload strings and configuration.
rule_body: rule LockBit_3_Payload { meta: family="LockBit" strings: $s1 = "LockBit" ascii wide $s2 = ".onion" ascii wide $s3 = { 55 8B EC 83 EC 40 53 56 57 } condition: 2 of them }

title: Qakbot Config Marker
author: Yara-Rules community
description: Detects Qakbot / Qbot configuration markers in dropped payloads.
rule_body: rule Qakbot_Config { meta: family="Qakbot" strings: $c1 = "qbot_" $c2 = { 89 5D FC 8B 45 08 } condition: uint16(0)==0x5A4D and all of them }

title: PHP Webshell — Generic Eval/Base64
author: Florian Roth
description: Detects PHP webshells that use eval(base64_decode(...)) obfuscation.
rule_body: rule PHP_Webshell_Eval_Base64 { meta: type="webshell" strings: $a = "eval(base64_decode" nocase $b = "$_POST" $c = "$_REQUEST" condition: $a and any of ($b, $c) }

title: APT29 WellMess Backdoor
author: Florian Roth
description: Detects APT29 WellMess backdoor variants (Cozy Bear).
rule_body: rule APT29_WellMess { meta: actor="APT29" family="WellMess" strings: $s1 = "botnet_id" $s2 = "wellmess" nocase $s3 = { 47 6F 6C 61 6E 67 } condition: 2 of them }

title: PowerSploit Invoke-Mimikatz Cradle
author: Florian Roth
description: Detects PowerSploit Invoke-Mimikatz reflective PE loader in PowerShell.
rule_body: rule Invoke_Mimikatz_Cradle { meta: family="PowerSploit" strings: $s1 = "Invoke-Mimikatz" ascii wide $s2 = "ReflectivePEInjection" ascii wide condition: any of them }

title: Meterpreter Reflective DLL
author: Yara-Rules community
description: Detects reflective DLL bytes used by Metasploit Meterpreter.
rule_body: rule Meterpreter_Reflective { meta: framework="Metasploit" strings: $s1 = { FC 48 83 E4 F0 E8 } $s2 = "ReflectiveLoader" ascii wide condition: any of them }
